# Synthetic acceptance samples

These files contain no personal data. `reference.json` records independently checkable expected values.

- `sample.csv`: three rows, leading zeros, Chinese, quoted comma/newline, repeated name and formula-like text. Keep codes as strings. Numeric amounts sum to 28. CSV downloads must escape the formula-like field rather than executing it.
- `sample.srt`: two bilingual cues. Export/import must keep both intervals and strings; shifting +500 ms produces starts of 1500 and 3500 ms.
- Image, QR, PDF and audio samples are generated by the existing browser suites. PDF pages/forms and WAV PCM are inspected independently of the page's success message. Corrupt/oversized fixtures are constructed in memory by boundary suites to avoid committing large files.

Never substitute private documents, passwords, signatures or recorded conversations into a public test report. Captured network evidence should retain request categories and hostnames, not tokens or private request bodies.
